foundation.purpose: Plan a small cafe's weekly shifts, show each person their own shifts, and handle swap requests.
foundation.traffic: One manager and eight staff, mostly on phones, a few times a day.
foundation.data: People (manager or staff), weeks (draft or published), shifts (day, start, end, person), swap requests (shift, from, to, status).

pathRecommended.because: This path matches your confirmed application scope and stage. Pick another one to change it.

pages.name: Sign in
pages.purpose: Manager and staff sign in; a staff member changes their starting password the first time.

pages.name: Plan the week
pages.purpose: The manager adds shifts for a week and publishes it.

pages.name: Staff
pages.purpose: The manager adds and removes staff members.

pages.name: My shifts
pages.purpose: A staff member's own published shifts, soonest first, with a button to ask for a swap.

pages.name: Swap requests
pages.purpose: The manager approves or turns down swap requests.
